items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: my first attempt actually was with Malcolm Janay. We just had a duet there for about two or three years during high school. And then the banjo bums was organized in 1955.

ctx.x: And we've got some notes here on the Banjo Bombs records that you started out on piano at eight? That's about right. Mm-hmm. And when you were 10, you were playing clarinet in the grammar school band. No, that's a mistake.

Mm-hmm. That was Malcolm Janay that they had referred to there and then got it mixed up. Now, the next thing I started playing was guitar. And then from guitar to you being lazy guitarist and then to banjo. And bass came in there about 1951. What kind of a bass? Bass horn, susaphone, tuba. Mm-hmm.
And you continued on that very long?
